root_cause_label: Wrong I/O Interface: C program reads custom binary format instead of .ckpt/.bpe files as required by task CLI
one_sentence_failure_summary: At step 1 the agent designed the C program to read a custom flat binary (model.bin, vocab.bin) with numeric token IDs instead of directly parsing the .ckpt and .bpe files specified in the task CLI, creating a fundamental interface mismatch that all 10 steps built upon without ever being recognized.
t_err_evidence: Step 1 creates /app/gpt2.c with main() expecting 'model.bin vocab.bin [ctx_ids]' and load_model()/load_vocab() reading a custom flat binary format; the task requires './a.out gpt2-124M.ckpt vocab.bpe "<input string>"' with direct TF .ckpt and .bpe parsing in C.
t_commit_evidence: The entire trajectory (steps 2-10) builds auxiliary Python conversion scripts and refines the C program within this wrong architecture; no step pivots to fixing the I/O interface, making failure locked in from step 1.
trigger_explanation: The agent never read or properly internalized the explicit task CLI specification requiring the C binary to accept .ckpt and .bpe file paths and a text string as arguments. Instead it immediately designed a different I/O contract (custom binary format + numeric token IDs), then added Python helper scripts around it, never returning to check against the stated requirement.
